read_model: read a colmap-style reconstruction model from a directory in text or binary format
write_model: write cameras, images, and points3D data to a colmap-style model directory in text or binary format
build_composite_image: build a composite image by stitching two images side by side or stacked vertically with configurable margins
load_image: load and preprocess an image by cropping the center square and resizing to a target width
qvec2rotmat: convert a quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix
